Zenithy La Ville

Villa in Koh Kaew
HomeNew ProjectsZenithy La Ville

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A gated boutique community of 22 two-storey pool villas in Koh Kaew, aimed at families and long-term investors who want schools and marinas close by. Each villa has three en-suite bedrooms, a mezzanine and a private pool with Jacuzzi, and the site is not within walking distance of a beach.

Facilities & amenities

  • 24/7 security
  • CCTV
  • Covered parking
  • Swimming pool with poolside
  • Private pool with Jacuzzi per villa
  • Automatic gate with video intercom
  • Landscaping and pool maintenance services
